concerns.text: The core research question requires elemental EDS maps to compute spatial correlation metrics, yet no verified source for any EDS maps is provided. FR‑001 assumes availability of public EDS maps from the NREL Perovskite Database and Zenodo, but the dataset list explicitly states “NO VERIFIED SOURCE”. Without an alternative dataset or a concrete acquisition strategy, the primary analysis (spatial metric extraction and correlation with PCE) cannot be performed, rendering the project unable to answer its central hypothesis. Provide a verified dataset citation for EDS maps or adjust the scope to a research question that can be answered with the available performance data alone.
